name: Lappidoth
title: Deborah's husband
summary: Lappidoth is known as the husband of the prophetess and judge Deborah. He is mentioned only once in the Bible, and his name means 'torches' or 'flames'. Apart from being Deborah's husband, we know very little about his life and work.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned as Deborah's husband
keyEvents.description: Lappidoth is briefly introduced in the Bible as the husband of the prophetess Deborah, who judged Israel at that time.
